title: Volunteers help in different ways

summaryZh: 英国250个志愿团体获奖：从儿童自行车借用到足球和社区花园，服务形式各不相同。

sentences.text: On 14 November 2026, the UK government announced an award for 250 groups led by volunteers.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月14日，英国政府宣布向250个由志愿者主导的团体授奖。

sentences.text: The King’s Award for Voluntary Service is the highest award for a voluntary group in the UK.
sentences.zh: 国王志愿服务奖是英国志愿团体的最高荣誉。

sentences.text: The winning groups help their communities in many different ways.
sentences.zh: 获奖团体以多种不同的方式帮助各自的社区。

sentences.text: In Worcestershire, Evesham Adventure Playground Association runs activities for children and young people.
sentences.zh: 在伍斯特郡，伊夫舍姆冒险游乐场协会为儿童和年轻人开展活动。

sentences.text: It also has a project that gives old bikes a new life and a bike library for children.
sentences.zh: 它还有一个让旧自行车重新发挥作用的项目，以及儿童自行车借用服务。

glosses.zh: 借用服务（此处为自行车）

sentences.text: In County Londonderry, the Harry Gregg Foundation offers football sessions for young people with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 在伦敦德里郡，哈里·格雷格基金会为残障年轻人提供足球活动。

sentences.text: At Caldmore, volunteers hold gardening sessions and community events on land that was once unused.
sentences.zh: 在卡尔德莫尔，志愿者在一片曾经闲置的土地上举办园艺活动和社区活动。

sentences.text: People can visit this green space every day.
sentences.zh: 人们每天都可以到访这片绿地。

sentences.text: This year, 87% of the awards went to groups outside London and the South East.
sentences.zh: 今年，87%的奖项授予了伦敦及英格兰东南部以外地区的团体。

sentences.text: The awards cover different services, not just one kind of volunteering.
sentences.zh: 这些奖项涵盖不同服务，而不仅是一种志愿活动。

sentences.text: People can now nominate groups for the 2027 awards, with nominations closing on 1 December 2026.
sentences.zh: 现在可以提名团体参加2027年评选，提名于2026年12月1日截止。

words.zh: 借用服务（此处为自行车）

phrases.zh: 新的生命／重新发挥作用

sentences.note: 注意本句的时态和时间关系，将当前事实与下一步安排区分开。

questions.text: Which of these activities would you like to help with, and why?
questions.zh: 你想协助其中哪一种活动，为什么？

expressions.text: I would like to help with … because …
